_comment: Per-role listening of the supervision sessions (read by monitoring.sh, session-wake.sh, team-watch-deliver.sh, the monitoring-rearm Stop hook and the operator kit's mail-guard): team_watch = the role is a team-watch receiver; wake = the wake-loop sources with their grace seconds (team-prompts, mail, pending), empty = no loop; pause.pass = what still reaches a paused role (alarms: true, mail_threads: thread-name prefixes); start = steps of monitoring.sh start from a fixed allow-list; remind_secs = a source item already present at arm time wakes only after this long. The values below are example policy: the Operator may change them per project (a broken pass falls back to alarms plus incident- threads, never to nothing).
